stem:
A function f is defined by

$$\text{f}(x) = \begin{cases} \frac{3x^2}{a^3} & 0 \leqslant x \leqslant a, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise,} \end{cases}$$

where $a$ is a constant.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Show that f is a probability density function for all positive values of $a$.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.stem: The random variable $X$ has probability density function f and the median of $X$ is 2.
parts.text: Show that $a = 2.52$, correct to 3 significant figures.
